examples.title: Rows on one rounded surface
examples.description: The header and footer sit outside the group, rows are linked as a whole, and separators start at the text.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { GroupedList, GroupedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import Wifi from '@lucide/svelte/icons/wifi';
</script>

<GroupedList header="Wi-Fi" footer="Known networks join automatically.">
  <GroupedListItem href="/settings/home" leadingKind="icon">
    {#snippet leading()}<Wifi size={20} />{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Home{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Connected{/snippet}
    {#snippet trailing()}Strong{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem href="/settings/office" selected>
    {#snippet leading()}<Wifi size={20} />{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Office{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Known network{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem>
    {#snippet leading()}<Wifi size={20} />{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Cafe{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
</GroupedList>

examples.title: A lead column and a fixed action column
examples.description: The lead column and the action column have fixed widths, so a longer value in one row never moves another row or a click target.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, GroupedList, GroupedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<GroupedList header="Runs">
  <GroupedListItem href="/runs/1">
    {#snippet lead()}45 min left{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Nightly backup{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Running{/snippet}
    {#snippet action()}<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Pause">Pause</Button>{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem href="/runs/2">
    {#snippet lead()}9:30{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Index rebuild, which has a much longer name that wraps onto a second line{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Scheduled{/snippet}
    {#snippet action()}<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Run now">Run</Button>{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
</GroupedList>

examples.title: A quick-add first row
examples.description: A leading accent plus and a borderless input. Return submits the text to onItemAdd and clears the input.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { GroupedList, GroupedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let tasks = $state(['Buy oat milk', 'Call the plumber']);
</script>

<GroupedList header="Today" onItemAdd={(value) => (tasks = [value, ...tasks])} addLabel="Add a task">
  {#each tasks as task (task)}
    <GroupedListItem>
      {#snippet title()}{task}{/snippet}
    </GroupedListItem>
  {/each}
</GroupedList>
